title: The map, again
logline: Tuesday. The invitation has a map printed inside: the island, the ferry, the pavilion. Wood looks at it beside the map he drew her in 1999, which he doesn't have — she has it. He draws it from memory. It's wrong in the same places.

panels.composition: The garage. The invitation open: a printed map inside, elegant, the island and the ferry route. WOOD looking at it. BARNABY.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man looking at an elegant printed map inside a cream wedding invitation, an old dog beside him

panels.composition: The printed map. Clean lines. A ferry route dotted. The pavilion, a star.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a cleanly printed invitation map with a dotted ferry route and a star for a venue

panels.composition: Wood drawing beside it, from memory, the 1999 map: Seattle, the needle, the streets he made up. He doesn't have the original. She does.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man redrawing from memory a hand-drawn map of a city with a needle tower beside a printed invitation map
image.notes: The 1999 map (dw_1999-03-26, packed in dw_2000-10-18). Redrawn from memory; the original is hers.

panels.composition: The two maps side by side. His, wrong in the same places it was wrong in 1999. He can tell. He leaves them wrong.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, two maps side by side on a table, one printed and precise and one hand-drawn and deliberately inaccurate, a man looking at both, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Her map printed; his redrawn, wrong in the same places.
